description: This PHP source file defines the ModuleDao class, which manages module entries in the ohrm_module database table, including retrieving module lists, updating module statuses, and managing data group permissions related to modules within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ModuleDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing modules and related data group permissions in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Module entities from the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of modules based on provided array and dispatches status change events.

methods.name: getDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of module names that are currently disabled.

methods.name: getEnabledModuleNameList
methods.description: Returns a list of module names that are currently enabled.

methods.name: updateDataGroupPermissionForWidgetModules
methods.description: Updates read permissions for a data group associated with widget modules.

methods.name: getDataGroupByDataGroupName
methods.description: Retrieves a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getUserRolePermissionsByDataGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for user roles associated with a specific data group ID.
